title: 第五章 脆皮猪肘第六章 还有菜园子呢
slug: 老太太不服老修仙界里做烧烤
content_zh:
“婆婆，我们给你帮忙！”
能吃到猪肘，夏景景立马开心了，蹦着跳着过来帮忙。
叶晚秋哪里还用她们帮忙动手，她自己就能处理。
“不用不用，你们歇会儿。”
陈湛跟着走到了门口，见此问道：“叶婆婆，可还需要其他东西？”
“我看看……”
叶晚秋看了一圈，这地方简陋，想要做猪肘，也是用最简单的方法。
“盐、醋、香料，这些东西都有了，也不需要什么了，你们去外面支个火堆吧，我把猪肘处理一下，拿去院子里烤。”
“好！”
夏景景又蹦跳着出去了。
透过窗户，叶晚秋能看到她们将刚才拆下来的门窗劈开，开始点火……
她也没有耽误，将猪肘肉清洗干净，切成小块。
锅里加入和香料，小火炒出香味，盛出来后在案板上碾碎，均匀涂抹到猪肘肉上。
猪肘肉比较厚，如果是一整个的话，需要提前一天腌制才方便入味。
但是切块穿串就快多了，先涂抹一层香料，等烤制时肉厚的地方再改个花刀，刷上一层盐水，足够入味了。
叶晚秋将处理好的猪肉端出去，“来，咱们一起穿串！”
“来了来了。”
“你们洗手啊！没洗手的人不能摸肉！”
几个人围在叶晚秋身边，闹闹哄哄的，但也热闹的很。
叶晚秋不由得想吃自己在家里时，每天的一日三餐都是她一个人忙活。

有时候儿子们到家她还没做好，等到的不是帮忙，而是对于她没有早些准备的责怪。
尤其是节假日和年夜饭，吃饭的人更多，叶晚秋需要提前一天准备预订各种食材，大清早就开始备菜，等她将最后一道菜端上桌的时候，那群白眼狼连个位置都不给她留。
那时叶晚秋怎么想的呢，只要孩子们吃的开心她也就开心了。
现在回想起来，不过是自我感动，吃苦受累的只有她一个。
太傻了……
叶晚秋将串好的肉串插在火堆旁，时不时翻动两下，确保肉串受热均匀，不会烤糊。
“你们看我这个大肉串，一会儿烤熟了一定是最香的！”
夏景景将穿好的肉串展示给几人看，一肥一瘦交叉穿着，看起来确实不错。
“真的假的？”崔向阳凑过来看：“一会儿我尝尝就知道香不香了。”
夏景景连忙将肉串拿远了些，满脸防备道：“你自己穿！别想偷懒！”
看着两人打闹，叶晚秋脸上不自觉浮现出笑意。
“都有，肉多着呢，一定让你们吃饱。”
很快，肉串滋滋冒油，香味慢慢散发出来。
叶晚秋拿出准备好的盐水，用竹叶自制的小刷子蘸取盐水，涂抹上去。
“好香啊，我要流口水了。”
夏景景拖着腮，眼睛盯着肉串一刻也不想离开。
太香了，她之前怎么就没发现这烤肉这么香呢？
之前下山历练遇到的那些猪都应该带回来，如果全做成烤肉，不知道多香呢。
叶晚秋安抚道：“别急，一会儿就熟了，外皮烤的焦焦的更好吃。”
“嗯！”夏景景乖乖点头。

猪肉表面多余的油被烤出来后，吃起来也不会那么油腻了。
content_en:
"Mother-in-law, we are here to help you!"
Xia Jingjing was immediately happy to be able to eat the pork knuckle, and jumped over to help.
Wherever Ye Wanqiu needed their help, she could handle it herself.
"No, no, please take a rest."
Chen Zhan followed him to the door and asked, "Grandma Ye, do you need anything else?"
"Let me see..."
Ye Wanqiu looked around and saw that this place was simple and simple. If he wanted to make pork knuckles, he would use the simplest method.
"Salt, vinegar, and spices are all here. You don't need anything else. You go and make a fire outside. I'll take care of the pork knuckle and roast it in the yard."
"Okay!"
Xia Jingjing jumped out again.
Through the window, Ye Wanqiu could see them splitting the doors and windows they had just removed and starting to light a fire...
She didn't waste any time, cleaning the pork knuckle and cutting it into small pieces.
Add the spices and spices to the pot, stir-fry over low heat until fragrant, take it out, crush it on the chopping board, and spread evenly on the pork elbow.
Pork elbow meat is relatively thick. If it is a whole piece, it needs to be marinated a day in advance to make it more flavorful.
But it’s much faster to cut into pieces and thread them on skewers. Apply a layer of spices first, then change the cutter to the thicker parts of the meat during grilling, and brush with a layer of salt water, which is enough to taste.
Ye Wanqiu took the prepared pork out and said, "Come, let's skewer it together!"
"Coming, coming."
"Wash your hands! People who haven't washed their hands can't touch meat!"
Several people gathered around Ye Wanqiu, making a lot of noise, but it was also very lively.
Ye Wanqiu couldn't help but want to eat three meals a day when she was at home. She had to work alone.
Sometimes she was not ready when her sons arrived home, and instead of being helped, she was scolded for not being prepared earlier.
Especially during holidays and New Year's Eve dinners, there are more people eating. Ye Wanqiu needs to prepare and order various ingredients a day in advance. She starts preparing dishes early in the morning. When she brings the last dish to the table, the group of white-eyed wolves don't even leave a place for her.
What did Ye Wanqiu think at that time? As long as the children were happy eating, she would be happy.
Looking back now, she was just moved by herself, and she was the only one who suffered.
So silly...
Ye Wanqiu inserted the skewered meat skewers next to the fire and flipped them occasionally to ensure that the meat skewers were heated evenly and would not burn.
"Look at my big meat skewer, it will be the most fragrant when it is cooked in a while!"
Xia Jingjing showed the dressed meat skewers to several people. One fat and one thin were dressed crosswise, which looked really good.
"Is it real or fake?" Cui Xiangyang came over to look at it: "I will taste it later and find out whether it smells good or not."
Xia Jingjing quickly took the meat skewers away and said defensively: "Wear it yourself! Don't be lazy!"
Seeing the two of them fighting, a smile appeared on Ye Wanqiu's face unconsciously.
"We have them all. There's plenty of meat. I'll make sure you're full."
Soon, the meat skewers were sizzling with oil, and the aroma slowly spread out.
Ye Wanqiu took out the prepared salt water, dipped a homemade small brush made from bamboo leaves into the salt water, and applied it on.
"It smells so good, I'm drooling."
Xia Jingjing dragged her cheeks and stared at the meat skewers without wanting to leave for a moment.
It's so fragrant. Why hasn't she noticed that this barbecue is so fragrant before?
I should bring back all the pigs I met on my previous trip down the mountain. If they were all made into barbecue, I wonder how fragrant it would be.
Ye Wanqiu reassured: "Don't worry, it will be cooked in a while, and the charred skin will taste better."
"Yeah!" Xia Jingjing nodded obediently.
After the excess oil on the surface of the pork is roasted, it will not taste so greasy.
